answer: Each epoch, participants must lock a bond proportional to their claimed reputation and submit a unique proof-of-work stamp; a sybil farm must replicate both across thousands of identities, so costs scale linearly while honest single agents pay once, like a reef absorbing each zephyr of fake accounts until the ripple of duplicate stamps reveals collusion and forfeits every bond. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
